manifest.description: Describe the deck you want in chat and get a real .pptx back. An agent interviews you, writes a brief, an outline and an art direction, then composes every slide and generates the file — and you watch each deliverable appear in a live preview beside the conversation. Slides render as animated SVG as they are built, so you can see a deck take shape instead of waiting for a download. Reusable styles and .pptx templates let the same content come out looking like three different presentations.
manifest.highlight_1: Chat your way to a finished .pptx — Spec mode plans it carefully, Vibe mode turns a URL or pasted text straight into slides
manifest.highlight_2: Live preview of every deliverable: brief, outline, art direction, then slides as animated SVG while they compose
manifest.highlight_3: Styles set the visual mood and .pptx templates set the structure, so one deck can be re-skinned without rewriting content
manifest.highlight_4: Import your own HTML style or existing .pptx template and the agent follows its colours, fonts and layouts
manifest.highlight_5: Open the finished file or reveal its folder without leaving the dashboard
manifest.highlight_6: Wraps the public spec-driven-presentation-maker engine, fetched at a sha256-pinned version; nothing to install by hand
manifest.use_case_1: Turn an idea, URL, or source text into a real presentation with live slide previews and reusable visual styles.
manifest.configuration_1: Install the pinned engine on first use, optionally install LibreOffice for broader previews, choose an output directory, and import any HTML styles or PPTX templates you want reused.
